# _🌿About the resource pack🌿_
Resource pack adding the slightest innovations, beautiful improvements, particle refinement, bug fixes and many other small details on which this resource pack specializes.
## _Why do I need a pack resource?💭_
This resource pack will seem very interesting to players who are tired of ordinary textures or minecraft seems underdeveloped, it fixes bugs created by modjang and redesigned various particles.

# _What exactly is the Pack Resource doing?_
<details>

  A bucket of water,
 A bucket of milk,
 All banner patterns,
 All non-zerite items,
 All music CDs,
